observations: Historical name generation selects a repertoire by culture, religion and birth year, samples family and form from separate deterministic streams and either retains an inherited surname or selects one. The generated catalog, dependency sampler, actual demographic inputs and all callers are separate roles.

Historical PersonalNameIdentity uses distinct authored, resolved and unresolved variants; rendering calls validate before selecting culture/register/sex forms and constructing a bounded RenderedPersonalName. Semantic reference IDs are public string wrappers, while validation verifies catalog relationships and inherited surname metadata. An empty unresolved candidate set is intentionally allowed by a source test; ingress and persistence of identities before rendering remain open.
